sections.title: Part Ⅰ TASK A. Readback and Hearback

body.label: Delivery
body.text: HL123, squawk 4162, ident.
MIRYA TWO departure, HARAN

body.label: Delivery
body.text: HL123, cleared to Pohang via MIRYA TWO departure, HARAN transition, climb to 5,000 feet, departure runway tree four.

body.label: Center
body.text: HL123, climb to flight level tree tree zero, maintain two eight zero knots until level.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, descend to 2,500 feet, cleared for the ILS runway one niner approach, braking action reported good.

sections.title: Part Ⅰ TASK B. Checking, Clarifying, Confirming, Informing

body.text: After departure Tower cleared you to fly runway heading. At 2,000 feet you had to turn right to zero four zero to stay clear of a build-up, and you are still on that heading. You have not been able to tell anyone yet. Listen to the controller and respond accordingly with a reason.

body.label: Departure
body.text: HL123, confirm maintaining runway heading?
Your crosswind limit on a wet runway is two five knots, and the runway is wet today. Listen to the tower, respond accordingly, and tell him your limit.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, crosswind on runway one four is one eight knots. Are you able to accept runway one four?
Gangneung Control / request with a reason / present level

While you were taxiing you saw a large piece of rubber lying on taxiway Sierra, but you were busy with the checklist and did not report it. Tower now calls you. Give a full readback, and report what you saw.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, cleared for takeoff runway tree four, wind tree 50 at 6.
You are heavy today. The best rate of descent you can give without exceeding your speed limit is 1,500 feet per minute. Listen to the controller, respond with a reason, and tell him what you can do.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, I need 2,500 feet per minute or better for descending traffic. Can you do that?

The arrival information you have says runway one niner is in use. The approach controller has just cleared the aircraft ahead of you for an approach to runway zero one, and you heard it on the frequency. You are not sure which runway you will get. Contact approach. Make a confirmation and clarify your intention.

sections.title: Part Ⅱ TASK A. Role-play & Follow-up

pre.text: Initial Situation You are the pilot of HL123 at Gwangju Airport, ready to start for Ulsan. You have information Hotel and runway tree four is in use. Your required takeoff distance today is 2,600 metres, and your slot time out of Gwangju is 0640Z. It is now 0612Z.

body.text: Gwangju Delivery / information Hotel
Contact Gwangju Delivery, request your ATC clearance, and advise that you are ready to start.
NAKDO TWO departure
Listen to the delivery controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Delivery
body.text: HL123, Gwangju Delivery, cleared to Ulsan as filed, NAKDO TWO departure, climb to 5,000 feet, squawk 2607. Start up approved.
Listen to the ground controller, give a full readback, and inquire how long it will take.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, Gwangju Ground, taxi to holding point Delta two via Mike and Sierra. There's a Boeing 767 under tow crossing Sierra ahead of you, so you may be stopped for a few minutes — I'll keep you posted.

pre.text: Situation Update You have stopped on Mike, just short of Sierra. The Boeing 767 under tow is still on Sierra in front of you.

body.text: Mike / Sierra / Delta two
Listen to the ground controller, respond accordingly, and report your position.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, are you holding short of Sierra now, or are you still back on Mike?
Listen to the ground controller, state your decision with a reason, and tell him the figure you need.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, I can send you round via Kilo to Delta one and you'd be moving in about five minutes, but you'd only have 2,400 metres from there. Or you wait eight minutes for Sierra. Up to you.
Listen to the ground controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Ground
body.text: HL123, the tow is clear. Taxi to holding point Delta two via Sierra, contact Gwangju Tower on 122.2 when ready.
Listen to the tower and give a full readback.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, Gwangju Tower, behind the landing A320, line up and wait runway tree four.

pre.text: Situation Update It is now 0637Z and you are number one at holding point Delta two.

body.text: Listen to the tower and provide both pieces of information.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, I've lost your slot time — say it again for me, and tell me whether you can be airborne in the next tree minutes.
Listen to the tower and give a full readback.

body.label: Tower
body.text: HL123, cleared for takeoff runway tree four, after departure climb to 5,000 feet, report passing tree thousand.

pre.text: Situation Update You are airborne and passing tree thousand feet, climbing to 5,000 feet.

body.text: Contact Gwangju Departure, report your passing altitude, and request further climb.
Follow up question.

In this situation, Ground offered you a shorter taxi route that would have left you with less runway. What did you compare before you answered, and why? In your role as a pilot, how do you keep track of the figures you need — slot times, runway lengths, fuel — while you are busy on the ground? Give an example of a figure you have had to ask a controller to repeat.

sections.title: Part Ⅱ TASK B. Extended Role-play : Single Incident/Emergency Related

pre.text: Initial Situation You are the pilot of HL123, descending through flight level one niner zero for one one thousand, 70 miles from SOBAEK, inbound to Yeosu Airport. You have information Kilo. Your required landing distance today is 1,900 metres.

body.text: Contact Yeosu Approach and report your position and level.
SOBAEK ONE arrival
Listen to the controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Yeosu Approach, descend to 9,000 feet, reduce speed to two five zero knots, expect the SOBAEK ONE arrival, ILS runway one seven, Yeosu altimeter two niner niner four.

pre.text: Situation Update Passing one two thousand feet you get a BRAKE SYSTEM 1 FAULT with ANTI-SKID INOP. The alternate brake system is working but your braking is degraded — your required landing distance is now tree,100 metres. There is no smoke and nothing else is affected.

body.text: Report your situation to the controller, name the fault, say what it means for your landing, and request priority.
Yeosu / Sacheon / landing distance available
Listen to the controller, state your decision with a reason, and tell him the distance you need.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, roger. Yeosu runway one seven has 2,800 metres available. Sacheon is one eight minutes away and has tree,200 metres. What would you like?
Listen to the controller, give a full readback and say your intentions.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, roger, turn left heading one zero zero, descend to 6,000 feet, vectors for Sacheon. Say your intentions.
Listen to the controller and answer both of his questions.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, two things for the fire service — is there any smoke or burning smell from the wheels, and do you want them standing by when you land?
Listen to the controller and provide both pieces of information.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, Sacheon wants it for the fire brief — say again the landing distance you need, and say again how many minutes you need before you are on the ground.

pre.text: Situation Update The brake fault has cleared. The alternate system is giving you normal braking and your required landing distance is back to 2,300 metres.

body.text: Listen to the controller, give him an update, state your decision with a reason, and say what you will need on the runway.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, if your braking is back I can turn you round for Yeosu runway one seven — 2,800 metres, and you'd be on the ground in niner minutes instead of one eight. Do you want it?
Listen to the controller and give a full readback.

body.label: Approach
body.text: HL123, turn right heading two two zero, descend to 2,500 feet until established, cleared for the ILS runway one seven approach, contact Yeosu Tower on 118.7.

body.text: What happened to your aircraft (HL123)? Explain the nature of the incident.
How do you think the incident was handled by the air traffic controller? Do you feel the situation could have been handled differently? Make a comment from a pilot's point of view.
